messages:
maya: Heads-up: I opened a docs PR with an SDK snippet + migration guide for the new batching behavior. Need reviews + merge before tomorrow's release cutoff (tomorrow 16:00 PT). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1423
andre: On it. I'll review by EOD. Are we gating the new example behind a feature flag?
maya: @andre yes — the SDK snippet uses the new `fast-batching` flag. We should call out how to opt-in and keep the example under the v1.2 docs path.
priya: I can do a content pass in the morning. CI preview link not created yet?
docs-bot: Preview build queued: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/1423 — lint step currently running.
liam: FYI lint failure on `snippets/sdk.md` — line 24: trailing whitespace. Quick fix in a follow-up commit will clear CI.
maya: pushed fix. snippet now: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate('Summarize recent logs', feature_flags=['fast-batching'])
print(resp.text)
```
priya: Looks good. Add a short migration note: 'If you relied on per-request batching semantics, enable `fast-batching` and adjust your timeout to >= 5s.'
sam: Product confirm: feature `fast-batching` is behind rollout. For tomorrow's release we will enable for internal customers only. Docs should mention 'opt-in via feature flag' and not mark as GA.
maya: Noted — I added a note. Also updated the versioned path `/v1.2/guides/` to avoid breaking existing links.
mandre: I left one nit about phrasing under "Performance tradeoffs" — please reword to avoid implying free latency gains.
maya: fixed the wording, pushed. preview link updated: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/1423/v1.2
docs-bot: Preview build passed ✅ — link: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/1423/v1.2
liam: We should gate merge until release branch cut? Release lead said merges into `main` must stop 1 hour before cutoff.
priya: Agree — can we target merge window: tomorrow 15:00 PT? That gives ops an hour to validate.
maya: Ok locking for merge at 15:00 PT. @andre @priya please approve by 14:30 PT so we can squash and merge.
mandre: Approved. :thumbsup:
priya: Approved. :white_check_mark: I'll watch for CI green.
sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled release window Tue 2026-03-24 20:00 UTC. Cutoff for PROD-affecting merges: 19:00 UTC (1 hour prior).
maya: Thanks — merging after final green. Will add note to release notes draft.
docs-bot: CI passed all checks ✅ — ready to merge.
maya: Merged. Commit: `docs: update fast-batching migration guide (#1423)` — SHA: a1b2c3d
priya: Nice! I'll add the migration snippet to the release notes and post an announcement on #product tomorrow.
sam: Confirmed internal rollout schedule updated. Thanks team.
